claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Canon DSLR with top Canon logo and body marking reading “EOS 800” (partially visible). The lens model/specs and whether an 18-55mm kit lens is included are not shown clearly, and UK-used/neat condition is not verifiable from the provided shots.

risks.risk: Model mismatch risk: photos read “EOS 800” (partially visible) which may not exactly confirm “800D” (or could be misread). Wrong model affects value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the full model name on the body (e.g., “EOS 800D”) and the exact lens label (e.g., “EF-S 18-55mm”).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case uncertainty: treat as an unconfirmed Canon DSLR kit with unknown exact model/lens.

risks.risk: Lens not confirmed: the witness did not capture the lens model/focal length/aperture, so it may not be the claimed 18-55mm kit lens or may be incomplete/damaged.
risks.proof: A sharp photo of the lens front ring and side text showing the exact lens model (e.g., “EF-S 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6 IS”) plus a photo of both lens caps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a body-only or unknown lens kit (worst case: assume lens condition/model unknown and potentially not the claimed kit).

risks.risk: Missing essentials: battery, charger, cables, strap, caps, hood, and memory card are not shown; without them, usability is limited.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all included items laid out (battery, charger, strap, caps, hood, manuals/box, and memory card if included).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete kit (worst case: no battery/charger/memory card).

risks.risk: Functional performance unknown: autofocus, shutter operation, and sensor health (dust/fungus/scratches) are not tested/shown.
risks.proof: A short video or clip: power on, autofocus on a face/text target, take a photo, and show the resulting image on the LCD; plus a close-up of the sensor/“dust check” image if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst case: assume possible faults until proven).

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition unknown: scratches, dents, rubber wear, and viewfinder/LCD clarity are not clearly assessable from the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the LCD (on/off), viewfinder area, grip rubber, and corners/edges for dents/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average-wear used condition (worst case: assume visible wear).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the full camera model text on the body (confirm “800D” vs any other EOS 800-series).
Clear close-up photos of the lens model/specs text (confirm it is exactly an 18-55mm kit lens) and show both lens caps.
Photo/clip of all included accessories laid out (battery, charger, strap, hood, cables, manuals/box, and memory card if any).
Short test clip: power on, autofocus on a clear target, and show a taken photo on the LCD.
Close-up photos of LCD and viewfinder clarity, plus grip rubber and any dents/scratches.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Canon DSLR and reads “EOS 800” on the body, but the key details that determine price—exact model confirmation and whether the claimed 18-55mm lens and essential accessories are included—are not verifiable from the provided shots. Missing these prevents a reliable worst-case price.
